title: Grade 4 Science — Mon, Jun 09
description: Food & Nutrition — Day 1 of 5: Introduction to nutrients
subject: science

questions.question: We eat food mainly to get ____.
questions.explanation: Food provides energy for daily activities and nutrients to keep the body healthy.

questions.question: How many main nutrients does our food contain?
questions.explanation: The five main nutrients are carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals.

questions.question: Which nutrient gives us the most energy for daily work?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are the body's main source of energy. Rice, wheat, and bread are rich in carbohydrates.

questions.question: Which nutrient helps our body grow and repair itself?
questions.explanation: Proteins are called body-building foods because they help in growth and repair of body tissues.

questions.question: Which nutrient keeps our skin healthy and helps us see in dim light?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A keeps skin healthy and helps in seeing in low light. Carrots and milk are good sources.

questions.question: Minerals and vitamins are needed by our body in ____ amounts.
questions.explanation: Vitamins and minerals are micronutrients — needed in small amounts, but they are essential for health.

questions.question: Which of these is rich in carbohydrates?
questions.explanation: Rice is mainly made of starch (a carbohydrate) and is the primary energy food for millions in India.

questions.question: Eating only one type of food is harmful because:
options: It misses other nutrients the body needs
It takes too long to cook
questions.explanation: A meal with only one food cannot provide all nutrients. We need variety for a balanced diet.

questions.question: Which of these is a protein-rich food?
questions.explanation: Dal (lentils) is an excellent plant source of protein, eaten daily in most Indian homes.

questions.question: Fats in food are used by the body to:
options: Store energy and keep us warm
questions.explanation: Fats store energy and help maintain body temperature. They also carry certain vitamins.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fat-rich food?
questions.explanation: Butter is rich in fat. Other fat-rich foods include ghee, nuts, and oils.

questions.question: Calcium is a mineral that helps build strong ____.
questions.explanation: Calcium makes bones and teeth strong. Milk, curd, and green vegetables are good sources of calcium.

questions.question: Which nutrient is found in fruits like oranges and lemons?
questions.explanation: Oranges, lemons, and amla are rich in Vitamin C, which keeps gums healthy and helps fight infections.

questions.question: A diet that contains all nutrients in right amounts is called a ____ diet.
questions.explanation: A balanced diet includes all five nutrients in the right quantities to keep the body healthy.

questions.question: Water is important for our body because it:
options: Helps in digestion and removing waste
questions.explanation: Water helps digest food, carry nutrients, and remove waste products from the body.
